dispositions.reason: The F019 p1 page is internally contradictory about which revision is current. The title-block cell prints 'Rev. no.' 00, but the same title block's DATE is 09-05-16, which is the date of revision-table row 01 ('AS PER CONSULTANT COMMENTS'); row 00 is dated 05-03-16. Frozen section 4 names where the page's 'own current revision' is normally read (the cell first; the table only when it is the only source). It does not say the cell wins when the page itself shows the cell may be out of date. Frozen section 2 defines 'ambiguous' as a case where 'which of several candidates is the field cannot be established from the page', which describes this page without any topic (i) amendment. The R32 disposer reached the same factual conclusion ('The image does not settle which revision is current'). The ruling is page-specific: no general cell-versus-table rule (topic (i)) is adopted. Two further reasons favour the conservative ruling. Under the frozen STOP-AND-SAFETY-RULES a critical acceptance on RESOLVED truth makes B terminal with the comparison INVALID, or makes C fail the safety gate, whereas one on unresolved truth is only reported; making a row the review itself calls contested into resolved truth creates a known path to an INVALID comparison. And revision is 38 >= 12 either way, so nothing is gained at the gate.
